ocrRegions.translatedText: What do I do? What do I do?!
A sleepyhead in class, a young swimmer.

ocrRegions.text: 就是她的秀场每周五天的竞技泳道
ocrRegions.translatedText: The competitive lanes she swims five days a week are her stage.
A medal favorite on her midsummer campaign.

ocrRegions.text: 交到接待处我忘了把报名表
ocrRegions.translatedText: I forgot to hand in the registration form at the reception desk!
...But... I have to get back to the lobby right away.
